8. Conclusion and Recommendations In total from HDBS point of view this was successful coring operation. In total we cut 108 meters of core with an overall recovery of 99, 2%. On core run #1 we encountered some tight spot getting to bottom, and some light reaming and lubrication was needed in order to get to bottom.
